newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - steady. Cash cattle trade seen remaining quiet with bids at $62 per cwt, steady with trade late last week, but feedlots holding out for higher money. Firming beef values supportive.
FEEDER CATTLE - up 0.10 to 0.25 cent. Weaker overnight CBOT corn prices could spark some early buying although latest CME feeder cattle index was lower.
LEAN HOGS - steady to 0.10 cent higher. Cash hogs seen around $0.50 higher Tuesday. Product values also firm.
PORK BELLIES - steady to up 0.25 cent. Recent light slaughter pace has tightened supplies and cash fresh belly market showing signs of strength.
